newsitem.title: INDIA: RTRS-Cricket: India win toss, elect to bat v South.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket: India win toss, elect to bat v South.

text.p: Indian skipper Sachin Tendulkar won the toss in the fifth one-day international match of the triangular series against South Africa and elected to bat in Rajkot on Tuesday.
Hosts India included offspinner Ashish Kapoor in place of injured left-handed opener Saurav Ganguly.
South Africa made two changes by including left-handed batsman and medium pacer Lance Klusener and right-handed batsman Herschelle Gibbs in place of Andrew Hudson and Brian McMillan.
The nine-match series also includes Australia.

India - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Navjot Sidhu, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Nayan Mongia, Sunil Joshi, Javagal Srinath, Anil Kumble, Ashish Kapoor, and Venkatesh Prasad. 12th man Salil Ankola.

South Africa - Hansie Cronje (captain), Gary Kristen, Darryl Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Lance Klusener, Herschelle Gibbs, Dave Richardson, Pat Symcox, Fanie de Villers, Alan Donald and Nicky Boje. 12th man Derek Crookes
